tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project in data/projects.json, optionally registering its whole task DAG (AI and human tasks with dependencies) in one call.

tasks.description: Optional initial tasks. Reference other tasks in this call by their temporary 'key'.

key.description: Temporary key used only inside this call to reference dependencies. Example: t1

description.description: Optional details about what to do.

assignee.description: Who performs the task: the agent (ai) or a person (human).

assignee_name.description: Optional person's name for a human task, e.g. 山田さん. Display only; the task still behaves as a human task.

depends_on.description: Keys of tasks that must finish first.

due.description: Optional due date or due text.

priority.description: Optional priority such as low, normal, high.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add one task. Without project_id the task goes to the Inbox project (single standalone TODOs). depends_on must use real task ids from the same project.

project_id.description: Target project id. Omit for a standalone TODO (goes to Inbox).

description.description: Optional details about what to do.

assignee.description: Who performs the task. Defaults to human.

assignee_name.description: Optional person's name for a human task, e.g. 山田さん.

depends_on.description: Existing task ids that must finish first.

due.description: Optional due date or due text.

priority.description: Optional priority such as low, normal, high.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Edit a task's fields: title, description, assignee, due, priority, and/or depends_on (validated against cycles).

project_id.description: Project id. Optional; the task is searched across projects when omitted.

assignee.description: New assignee. Setting it to ai clears assignee_name.

assignee_name.description: New person's name for a human task, e.g. 山田さん. Empty string to clear.

due.description: New due date or due text.

depends_on.description: New full list of dependency task ids.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Record a task's status transition (pending/running/done/failed/skipped) and an optional result summary.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional; the task is searched across projects when omitted.

result.description: Short outcome summary recorded with done/failed.

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Append a timestamped progress comment to a task. Use while working on a task to record progress notes.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional; the task is searched across projects when omitted.

tools.name: show_project
tools.description: Show one project with all tasks, dependencies, and which tasks are READY to start.

project_id.description: Project id. Defaults to the only active project (or the Inbox).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects with progress (done/total tasks and ready count). Can filter by status.

status.description: Filter status: active, done, or all.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks across all projects (or one project). status=open shows pending/running tasks.

status.description: Filter status: open, done, or all.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task by task id. Other tasks' dependencies on it are removed as well.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional; the task is searched across projects when omitted.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project and all of its tasks by project id.

tools.name: open_project_viewer
tools.description: Start the local project viewer (http://127.0.0.1:8765/) if needed and open it in the browser. Humans can create/edit projects and tasks there.

port.description: Viewer port. Defaults to LITTLE_AGENT_VIEWER_PORT or 8765.

project_id.description: Open the viewer focused on this project.
